title: Inline shape comment pins the wire contract at the fix site
description: The comment '// SSE data shape: {"changed": {"a-self": {"Message": "s-N", ...}}}' lives exactly where the path is traversed, making future changes self-evidently wrong if the shape diverges. A contributor might suggest moving this to a doc comment on the function — keeping it inline is correct because the shape is only relevant to this specific parse call, not the function as a whole.
